# Mesh Gradient (`meshGradient`)

Soft, grainy color fields drifting into each other.

- Type: scene (draws its own image; put it first)
- Reacts to: nothing outside itself (pure motion)
- Cost: light (~2.6 ms/frame at 5K on a Pro GPU)
- Built-in styles: Afterglow

## Params

| key | label | kind | range / options | default |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `speed` | Speed | slider | 0 … 2 | 0.6 |
| `scale` | Softness | slider | 0.5 … 2 | 1 |
| `hue` | Hue Spread | slider | 0 … 1 | 0.35 |
| `grain` | Grain | slider | 0 … 0.3 | 0.08 |

## Colours

| slot | label | default |
|---|---|---|
| `colorA` | Deep | {"r":0.13,"g":0.07,"b":0.34} |
| `colorB` | Light | {"r":1,"g":0.56,"b":0.42} |

## In a style

```json
{"kind": "meshGradient", "params": {"speed": 0.6, "scale": 1, "hue": 0.35}}
```
